title: Contextual alert composer — runbook cues & SLO trajectory preview
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Problem: Setting up alerts in the Console today is functional but disconnected from operational context. Engineers create alert rules without quick visibility into the runbook to follow, how the alert maps to SLOs, or the likely SLO trajectory if the alert fires. This increases noisy alerts, slows on-call responses, and leads to incorrect escalation decisions.

Goal: Design a contextual Alert Composer that surfaces runbook snippets, quick handoff copy for shift changes, and an interactive SLO trajectory preview. The composer should reduce mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) and mean time to remediate (MTTR) by making operational next steps and customer impact visible at creation time.

Scope: UI/UX for the new composer modal and the alert details panel. Prototype flows for: 1) creating an alert with runbook curation, 2) viewing SLO trajectory preview anchored to alert thresholds, and 3) a one-click "Prepare for shift" summary card that packages links and commands for the next on-call.

Out of scope: backend enforcement, SLO math changes, and duty-roster management (handled by infra/eng).
design_notes:
- Emphasize a left-to-right composer: Conditions -> Impact -> Runbook & Play -> Preview -> Save.
- Runbook cues should be editable inline (short text + anchor link to full runbook). Default to existing project runbooks if available.
- SLO trajectory preview uses a small sparkline with two states: current trend and projected impact if condition persists for X minutes. Use conservative defaults for projection period (e.g., 15m, 1h).
- Provide a compact 'Shift summary' that exports a checklist, runbook anchors, and top-3 mitigations for handoff messages.
- Accessibility: keyboard-first composer navigation and aria labels for dynamic previews.
- Trade-offs considered: embedding rich runbooks inline increases UI density; we chose a compact snippet with a prominent 'Open runbook' affordance to avoid cognitive overload.
- Performance: preview uses cached SLO snapshots to avoid runtime queries on every keystroke.
acceptance_criteria: Composer modal presents five steps: Conditions, Impact, Runbook & Play, Preview (SLO), Save
Inline runbook snippet appears when related runbook exists; user can edit snippet and save anchor link
SLO trajectory preview updates with condition threshold changes and shows time-to-breach estimates for 3 projection windows
Shift summary card can be generated from the composer and copied as plain text or a shareable link
Prototype usability test with 6 platform engineers yields median SUS >= 75 and identifies no catastrophic confusion on runbook linking
proposed_screens: Composer-Step-1-Conditions (rules builder with toggleable sample payload)
Composer-Step-2-Impact (SLO mapping selector and severity slider)
Alert-Detail-Panel (with Runbook anchors and 'Prepare for shift' button)
Compact-Preview-Toast (small embeddable preview for quick checks)
